newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Construction shrs up on hope for inter-Korean ties.
newsitem.headline: Construction shrs up on hope for inter-Korean ties.

text.p: South Korean construction shares rose in Monday morning trading on optimism that four-way peace talks could promote inter-Korean economic cooperation, brokers said.
The construction sub-index rose 7.98 points, or 2.96 percent, to 277.68 in the first 20 minutes of trading.
Hyundai Engineering and Construction rose 900 won to 19,000 and LG Construction added 500 won to 13,500.
South Korean media on Sunday expressed optimism that communist North Korea would agree to peace talks to defuse the world's last Cold War era flashpoint.

Earlier, media reports said Pyongyang had asked for a meeting with U.S. and South Korean officials to give an answer to four-way peace talks proposed last April by U.S. President Bill Clinton and his South Korean counterpart Kim Young-sam.
"Investors are raising hopes that icy relations between the two Koreas will melt and a bilateral economic relationship will be promoted," said a Sunkyong Securities analyst.
